clauses.clause: FR-09 — reason-code copy exists for every one of the five reason codes with a working fix link
evidence: client/src/features/booking/components/bookingErrors.js ELIGIBILITY_FIXES covers all five policy codes from src/modules/eligibility/policy.js REASONS (lines 46-52): EMAIL_UNVERIFIED, NAME_MISSING, PHONE_MISSING, HOST_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, HOST_AGREEMENT_MISSING — each with distinct WHAT ('what') and HOW ('how') copy plus fixPath '/account' and a specific fixLabel; USER_NOT_FOUND (the sixth policy code) is also covered with fixPath '/login'.
Fix links are real routes: '/account' and '/login' are declared in client/src/features/account/routes.jsx (lines 24-27), so every <Link to={item.fixPath}> resolves.

EMAIL_UNVERIFIED's fix is a working ACTION, not just a link: components/EligibilityNotice.jsx ResendVerification posts /api/auth/resend-verification (endpoint confirmed at src/modules/auth/routes.js line 88 and client/src/api/auth.js line 67) with the session user's email, renders the outcome visibly and announces it via aria-live.
Unknown reason codes render honestly (code + generic account link) instead of being dropped — describeEligibilityReasons fallback in bookingErrors.js.

Server shape matched: src/modules/eligibility/middleware.js answers 403 { error: { code: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', details: { action, reasons } } }; ReservePage.jsx reads err.details.reasons and renders <EligibilityNotice> plus an assertive announcement.

Tests: ReservePage.test.jsx 'renders WHAT is missing and HOW to fix it per reason code, with fix links' (asserts copy + /account hrefs for three guest-side codes) and 'EMAIL_UNVERIFIED resend really posts and announces the outcome' (asserts the POST body and the announced/visible confirmation). Host-side codes HOST_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE / HOST_AGREEMENT_MISSING cannot be produced by canReserveSeat, but their copy + links exist in the shared map, satisfying the clause.

clauses.clause: FR-12 / AB-02 — NO_CAPACITY and the pending-limit distinct
evidence: The pending-limit code on this tree is BOOKING_LIMIT (src/modules/bookings/service.js line 111: 409 with details { limit: config.booking.maxConcurrentPending }); NO_CAPACITY at line 156.

bookingErrors.js bookingErrorMessage renders DISTINCT copy per code: NO_CAPACITY = 'No seats are left on this listing — another guest took the last seat...'; BOOKING_LIMIT = 'You already have {details.limit} pending bookings — that is the per-guest limit...' with the limit read from the payload (and a limit-free fallback when details.limit is absent).

Tests: ReservePage.test.jsx 'NO_CAPACITY renders and announces its own message' and 'the per-guest pending cap (BOOKING_LIMIT) renders a distinct message with the limit from the payload' — the latter also asserts the NO_CAPACITY copy is NOT present, proving distinctness.

clauses.clause: FR-11 / ADR-009 — cap errors rendered from payload details; grep proving no 1/30/90 cap literal under client/src

quotedResult: client/src/features/account/routes.jsx:11:// NFR-12 / NFR-13 — /account hosts deletion (confirm dialog naming the 30-day erasure)
client/src/features/account/components/ExportSection.jsx:6,88,106 and client/src/api/users.js:9 — NFR-13 30-day statutory export SLA copy
capLiteralGrep.interpretation: ZERO hits are MEHKO cap values. Every 30/60/90 literal is NFR-12/NFR-13 30-day lifecycle copy, a time-unit conversion, or a comment example — none is a meals/listings cap. A cap-phrase grep (numeric literal within 30 chars of 'meal'/'listing') returned only photo alt-text indexing (index + 1), a time-format comment, and 'meals found' pluralization. Bare '\b1\b' in the booking subtree is only FIRST_PAGE = 1 pagination, pluralization ternaries, page arithmetic, a month-index conversion, and a test-fixture phone number — no cap semantics.
capLiteralGrep.moduleLevelAssertion: ReservePage.test.jsx 'the cap-rendering module carries NO cap-shaped numeric literal (ADR-009 grep)' asserts /\b(1|30|60|90)\b/ does not match components/bookingErrors.js at all — and it passes.

evidence: mehkoCapMessage (bookingErrors.js) names WHICH cap (Daily listing cap / Daily meal cap / Weekly meal cap) and WHEN it resets (next America/Los_Angeles calendar day; the Monday after details.weekEnd), reading limit, localDate, weekStart, weekEnd and alreadyScheduled EXCLUSIVELY from the server's error details.

Backend detail shapes matched: MEHKO_DAILY_LISTING_LIMIT 409 {localDate, limit}; MEHKO_DAILY_MEAL_LIMIT / MEHKO_WEEKLY_MEAL_LIMIT 422 incl. {weekStart, weekEnd, limit, alreadyScheduled} (build-plan G.2 contract, ADR-009 as amended by AB 1325: 1/30/90 — values live in src/config and in error payloads only).

Tests exercise NON-production cap values (limit 2, 25, 80; alreadyScheduled 21, 77) and assert they render — proof the copy is payload-driven, not constant-driven; plus bookingErrorMessage routes all three MEHKO codes to the same cap copy.

formatters.js formatCalendarDate renders 'YYYY-MM-DD' cap days at UTC midnight of the literal day — never re-projected through the viewer's timezone, so the day shown cannot drift off the day the server enforced.

clauses.clause: FR-14 — cancel gating by start time
evidence: BookingDetailPage.jsx: canCancel = booking.status === 'pending' && Date.parse(listing.scheduledStart) > Date.now() — cancel is offered ONLY on a pending booking strictly before the scheduled start, matching the server rule (repo.markCancelledBeforeStart; 409 CANCEL_TOO_LATE at/after start, src/modules/bookings/service.js lines 226-236).

At/after start the action is ABSENT and the screen says why ('The meal has started — this booking can no longer be cancelled.'); a cancelled booking shows the terminal state; other statuses get 'Only upcoming reserved bookings can be cancelled.'
The action sits behind the kit's confirm Dialog with initial focus on the SAFE action ('Keep the booking'); Escape closes without firing the POST and returns focus to the trigger (both tested).

Server-side refusal remains the enforcement: if the server declines anyway, CANCEL_TOO_LATE and BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE (with details.status, provided by the backend at service.js line 233-235) render as real sentences and are announced (tested).
Success path announces seat-restored + both-participants-notified and re-renders the cancelled state from the response body (tested).
Tests: BookingDetailPage.test.jsx FR-14 describe block — 4 specs covering dialog cancel, Escape, the absent-action-past-start state, and the CANCEL_TOO_LATE server refusal.

BookingDetailPage.jsx 'Meal completion' section renders BOTH flags (guest/host) as text with '(you)' on the caller's row, driven by booking.role + guestConfirmedCompletion/hostConfirmedCompletion — exactly the serializeBooking fields (src/modules/bookings/service.js lines 62-77).

The confirm action appears ONLY while status === 'in_progress' AND the caller's own flag is unset; after own confirmation the button is gone and 'You have confirmed — waiting for the other participant.' renders; a pending booking explains completion opens when the meal is in progress (server: 409 BOOKING_NOT_IN_PROGRESS, rendered + announced if forced).

The response's awaitingOtherParty drives the announcement: one confirmation announces awaiting-the-other; both-confirmed announces 'Meal completed', shows completedAt, and unlocks the /bookings/:id/review link (FR-05 completed-bookings-only).

Both perspectives tested: guest confirming first (awaitingOtherParty true) and host confirming against their own unset flag; response shape {booking, awaitingOtherParty} confirmed at src/modules/bookings/routes.js confirm-completion → res.json(result) and service.js line 344.
Tests: BookingDetailPage.test.jsx FR-04 describe block — 4 specs.

clauses.clause: FR-13 — surfacing statement (email is the ADR-011 channel; no in-app feed endpoint exists)
evidence: ReservePage.jsx states before confirm: 'Booking updates are confirmed by email — Homeplate notifies you and the host whenever this booking's status changes.'; the success announcement names the email confirmations.

BookingDetailPage.jsx Status section states: 'Email notifications are sent to both participants whenever this booking's status changes — reservation, cancellation and completion.'; cancel and completion announcements repeat the email statement.
BookingsListPage.jsx surfaces lifecycle status as text on every row (statusLabel + role), linking to the detail page that carries the statement.

This matches build-plan G.5(1)'s stated FR-13 reading exactly: no in-app notification endpoint exists on this tree (grep of src/routes and modules confirms), email via SendGrid is the ADR-011 channel, so wave 6 surfaces status changes and states that email notifications are sent. Tests assert the statement on both reserve ('confirmed by email') and detail ('Email notifications are sent to both participants') screens.

clauses.clause: NFR-07 — accessibility clauses checkable now, booking screens
clauses.verdict: PASS on audited routes; parameterized detail route unaudited by design until wave 7
evidence: npm run test:a11y on this tree: '/bookings (booking) — 0 serious/critical wcag2a+wcag2aa violations' and '/bookings/new (booking) — 0 serious/critical wcag2a+wcag2aa violations'; keyboard check 'first Tab reaches the skip link; activating it focuses #main' passes; booking-flow interface reported PRESENT (route /bookings); overall 7 of 7 NFR-07 interfaces exist; harness exits 1 (FAIL) listing 6 parameterized routes incl. /bookings/:bookingId as unaudited — exactly the honest wave-6 outcome build-plan G.1 mandates. Do not flip NFR-07 on this: UT-01 (human study) also remains.

Structural checks read from source: exactly one h1 per screen (asserted in tests); document.title via usePageTitle; filters labelled through FormField (getByLabelText passes); Dialog is the kit's focus-trapping modal with focus restore; every outcome both announced via the kit's role=status/alert live regions (region-scoped test helper) AND rendered as visible text; ListingSummary is a real dl/dt/dd; status conveyed as text, never colour alone; booking.module.css is token-only (no hex literals; spot-checked); anonymous states render sign-in links instead of dead controls; no images rendered in booking screens, so no alt-text exposure.

contractChecks: api.bookings.{create,list,getBooking,cancel,confirmCompletion} transcribe src/modules/bookings/routes.js exactly; response envelopes {booking}, {bookings,page,pageSize}, {booking,awaitingOtherParty} all matched against routes.js/service.js on this tree.

ApiError exposes .code and .details (client/src/api/errors.js lines 50-51); every booking-surface code the backend can emit (BOOKING_LIMIT, NO_CAPACITY, OWN_LISTING, LISTING_STARTED, LISTING_NOT_BOOKABLE, LISTING_NOT_FOUND, CANCEL_TOO_LATE, BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE, BOOKING_NOT_IN_PROGRESS, BOOKING_NOT_FOUND, NOT_PARTICIPANT, NOT_ELIGIBLE, VALIDATION_FAILED, AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, RATE_LIMITED) has a distinct human sentence in bookingErrorMessage; unknown codes fall back to the ApiError's own user-presentable message, never a stringified body.

ADR-010: booking screens render coarse location only (areaLabel/city[/region] via ListingSummary) with the honest '(approximate area — the exact address is shared with confirmed guests)' note; ZERO addressLine1/addressLine2/postalCode references anywhere under client/src/features/booking; serializeListingRef embeds no precise field, and the client never assumes one.
Session discipline: signed-in state from useSession() only; zero document.cookie under client/src (backend grep-gate test passes); 401 handling flips to the sign-in prompt.

Wave-6 parallel-work rule respected: cross-feature navigation by URL string only (/login, /signup, /account, /search, /listings/:id, /bookings/:id/messages|review|safety-alert); no import crosses a feature boundary; only wave-5 kit/api/session/layout modules are imported.
Traceability: every booking module carries an FR/NFR-cited header comment (routes.jsx, all three pages, all five components).

findings.detail: 1) tests/coverage/coverage-lane.test.js line 77 'wave-5 client foundation is ON disk; wave-6 feature screens are NOT yet (scope guard)' — asserts client/src/features/*/routes.jsx does not exist; wave 6 legitimately created five of them. 2) tests/adr-conformance/adr-wave5-client-invariants.test.js line 131 'no non-test client module dereferences a privileged address key unconditionally' — its own comment scopes it to 'Wave 5 ships no booking-gated screen'; the single offender is client/src/features/discovery/ListingDetailPage.jsx, whose dereference IS presence-guarded (lines 116-118) on the booking-gated payload ADR-010 explicitly permits. Both guards must be re-baselined for the wave-6 tree (the second should assert conditional access rather than absence). No booking file is implicated: the booking subtree has zero address-key references, and all 33 booking client specs pass.
findings.reproduce: TEST_STRICT_HANDLES=1 npm test → 'Test Suites: 2 failed, 61 passed, 63 total; Tests: 2 failed, 1395 passed, 1397 total' (99.4 s)

findings.title: Degenerate-payload edge: an unparseable scheduledStart on a pending booking renders 'The meal has started' untruthfully
findings.detail: canCancel requires Number.isFinite(startMs) && startMs > Date.now(); if the API ever returned a pending booking whose listing.scheduledStart fails Date.parse, beforeStart is false and the Cancellation section claims 'The meal has started — this booking can no longer be cancelled.' even though it has not. The server contract always supplies an ISO instant (serializeListingRef from a timestamptz column), so this is unreachable on the real API — recorded for completeness; neutral copy for the NaN case would remove it. Not gate-blocking.
findings.reproduce: Render BookingDetailPage with booking.status='pending' and listing.scheduledStart='not-a-date' (test harness).

findings.severity: observation (coordinator visibility, not a defect of any wave-6 unit)
findings.title: FR-11 client surfacing is a tested rendering contract with no live screen path yet
findings.detail: mehkoCapMessage fully implements payload-driven MEHKO cap copy and is unit-tested, but no wave-6 route lets a host create or update a listing (no /listings/new or listing-management screen exists; grep for a client createListing call site under features/ returns nothing), so no user can currently trigger a MEHKO cap error in the UI. This matches the §6 unit scoping (no wave-6 unit owned listing-management UI; U6-BOOKING's brief is FR-04/12/13/14) — flagged so FR-11's client-side surfacing is not marked complete beyond the rendering contract.
